description: This file defines an interface IBlobContainerFactory for creating and initializing blob storage container clients based on GrainId, used within Orleans framework for Azure Blob Storage integration.

classes.name: IBlobContainerFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating and initializing blob container clients based on GrainId.

methods.name: GetBlobContainerClient
methods.description: Returns a BlobContainerClient for the specified GrainId.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes dependencies using the provided BlobServiceClient and CancellationToken.
